svg.aria-label: Chart of the cost-per-day figures Ollie publishes in its own FAQ on 2026-09-26: food starts at less than 4 dollars a day for small dogs fed Ollie exclusively, and averages 8 dollars a day; below the bars, the per-meal starting prices printed on Ollie's Meal Plans page, 1.57 dollars for Full Fresh Meals and 1.00 dollar for the Half Fresh Plan, which are a different unit

g.text: How much does Ollie cost per day? The two numbers Ollie prints itself
Both figures come from the answer to "How much does Ollie cost?" on ollie.com/faqs, read 2026-09-26 (UTC+8).
Cost per DAY, as Ollie states it
Starts under $4 a day
small dogs fed Ollie exclusively
under $4
Averages $8 a day
the average Ollie prints in the same answer
$8 avg
Ollie: "Prices will vary based on the size of your dog and the size of their portions." Bars are Ollie's wording, not a quote for your dog.
Printed per MEAL instead - a different unit
$1.57 a meal
Full Fresh Meals, "Starting at"
$1.00 a meal
Half Fresh Plan, "Starting at"
Source: ollie.com/meal-plans. Ollie never prints a per-day price next to these.
Why the two units cannot be mixed
• $1.57 / $1.00 are per meal and are labelled "Starting at"
• under $4 and $8 are per day, from the FAQ answer
• Ollie does not publish meals per day or a conversion between them
• so the site never multiplies them, and neither does this page
What Ollie publishes about the bill itself:
starter box = your first two weeks of food + a welcome kit (scoop, puptainer) · account charged three days before the box ships, no edits after that · free delivery per the Meal Plans page title
subscription only · cancel on the website, not in the app (per dog) · ships to the continental United States, not Alaska or Hawaii
Sources read on 2026-09-26 (UTC+8): ollie.com/faqs (cost per day, billing, starter box, cancel, shipping) and ollie.com/meal-plans (per-meal starting prices, "Free Delivery" page title).
No figure on this chart is estimated, converted or taken from a third-party comparison site; if Ollie does not print it, the page says so.
